Q180.reason: A photo needs a witness who can testify it accurately depicts the subject, and the photographer identified only her own work, not the accuracy of the depiction of the tank.

Q181.reason: The two-year, 50-mile, any-aspect covenant is likely overbroad and unenforceable, and the $1,500 penalty falls with it, while the salary and 60-day termination terms are valid.

Q182.reason: The neighbor's remainder was a devisable fee simple, so it passed to the charity under her will, leaving the friend a life estate and the daughter with no interest to convey.
